description: S001 is a dated interview about the continuing internet-workers campaign and negotiations, but it does not establish a dated February public gathering or a state response at an assembly. The January freelancer event cannot be carried into February as a physical continuation from campaign continuity language alone.
required_followup: If a fresh research phase is authorized, compare the interview with the January E002 dossier and seek event-specific evidence for an in-February physical gathering before creating a continuation or event.

description: The RGZ protest headlines do not establish event date, attendance, demand, or state response. S007 attempt 1 was a technical Cache miss with no HTTP status/body (not a denial); attempt 2 had an incomplete fresh manual review and no body request was dispatched before phase close.
required_followup: In a separately authorized source-access phase, start a fresh exact-URL gate and complete every required review step before any dependent request; do not reuse the incomplete attempt-2 receipt chain.

description: The N1 Oslobođenje headline and Danas Kosovo-policy headline identify possible Presidency protest leads but provide no verified physical date, attendance, policy demand, or relation between the two topics.
required_followup: Review the source bodies only under a fresh authorized exact-URL gate; establish date and whether the two headlines concern one or separate episodes.

description: Danas, Nova.rs, and RFE/RL search headlines raise hospitality-worker protest leads. Publication dates, occurrence, relation among the items, turnout, exact demands, and possible event-day boundaries are not established.
required_followup: Determine whether the sources describe the same action or separate actions, whether an announced protest occurred, and whether any gathering began in February.

description: An NSPM search headline describes an event-industry/hospitality protest outside the Government. Its relation to E004 and exact date are unknown.
required_followup: Compare reviewed article dates, text, syndication/origin statements, and venue/time evidence before deduplicating or treating this as a separate event.

description: The multi-sector protest headlines are undated in most search results. The Naslovi URL path and separate Vesti/Danas archive title point to 14 March as a tentative discovery clue only; they do not prove event date, physical occurrence, source independence, or a match to the undated RTV BN headline.
required_followup: Keep the RTV BN headline as an undated lead. Verify each exact story and its event date in a separately authorized phase; do not count URL variants as separate events or infer independent reporting.

description: For all six candidate clusters, the available discovery metadata does not establish a numeric or qualitative attendance estimate sufficient for the 50-person threshold.
required_followup: Obtain event-specific attendance evidence and preserve the original wording and uncertainty. Keep threshold status pending until a qualifying count is supported.

description: No candidate has reviewed event-specific evidence for protester violence or any of the seven state-response dimensions: accommodation, arrests, beatings, crowd dispersal, ignore, killings, shootings. All remain unknown; campaign negotiations in S001 cannot be coded as a response to an undated gathering.
required_followup: For each event with a date and verified gathering, review explicit event-specific reporting for each response dimension; silence is not coded as no response.

description: Sixteen open-web search captures preserve 59 exact query strings and 471 ordered result headers. Queries cover the four February weekly windows in English and Serbian Latin/Cyrillic, plus freelancer/tax negotiations, hospitality/event workers, musicians/photographers, labor, environmental protest, national/regional media, government and public-institution records, and human-rights sources. This does not recreate LexisNexis or comprehensive local/regional archive access; ranking and indexing are incomplete and no exhaustive or zero-event conclusion is supported.
required_followup: If broader coverage is required, use authorized archived/local/regional sources and additional Serbian-language variants while preserving exact query/result captures and adding no unsupported absence claim.

description: The official baseline gate remains pending. This dossier is a reviewable open-web extension unit and does not assign original MM identifiers or alter the integrated catalogue.
required_followup: Coordinator completes baseline reconciliation and independent review before any integration decision.
